<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_OnlineShopPurchase"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/online-shop-purchase">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_OnlineShopPurchase" name="Online Shop Purchase" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OrderStarted" name="Order started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_01_Start_Login</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_LogIn" name="Log in to account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_01_Start_Login</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_02_Login_OrderFork</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_OrderFork" name="Split order activities">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_02_Login_OrderFork</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_03_OrderFork_SelectItems</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_04_OrderFork_SetPayment</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectItems" name="Select items to purchase">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_03_OrderFork_SelectItems</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_05_SelectItems_ItemsFork</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SetPaymentMethod" name="Set payment method">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_04_OrderFork_SetPayment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_08_SetPayment_PaymentJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ItemsFork" name="Split after item selection">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_05_SelectItems_ItemsFork</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_06_ItemsFork_ChooseReward</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_07_ItemsFork_PaymentJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ChooseReward" name="Choose free reward">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_06_ItemsFork_ChooseReward</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15_ChooseReward_FinalJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PaymentJoin" name="Join item selection and payment method">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_07_ItemsFork_PaymentJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_08_SetPayment_PaymentJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_09_PaymentJoin_PaymentSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PaymentSplit" name="Payment or installment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_09_PaymentJoin_PaymentSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10_PaymentSplit_Pay</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11_PaymentSplit_Installment</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Pay" name="Pay">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10_PaymentSplit_Pay</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12_Pay_PaymentMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CompleteInstallment" name="Complete installment agreement">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11_PaymentSplit_Installment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13_Installment_PaymentMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PaymentMerge" name="Payment completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12_Pay_PaymentMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13_Installment_PaymentMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14_PaymentMerge_FinalJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_FinalJoin" name="Join payment and reward">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14_PaymentMerge_FinalJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15_ChooseReward_FinalJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16_FinalJoin_DeliveryMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DeliveryMerge" name="Delivery needed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16_FinalJoin_DeliveryMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_21_ReturnItems_DeliveryMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17_DeliveryMerge_Deliver</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeliverItems" name="Deliver items">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17_DeliveryMerge_Deliver</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18_Deliver_ReturnSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReturnSplit" name="Items returned for exchange?" default="Flow_20_ReturnSplit_End">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18_Deliver_ReturnSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_19_ReturnSplit_ReturnItems</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_20_ReturnSplit_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReturnItems" name="Return items for exchange">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_19_ReturnSplit_ReturnItems</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_21_ReturnItems_DeliveryMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderCompleted" name="Order completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_20_ReturnSplit_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01_Start_Login" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderStarted" targetRef="Task_LogIn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02_Login_OrderFork" sourceRef="Task_LogIn" targetRef="Gateway_OrderFork"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03_OrderFork_SelectItems" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderFork" targetRef="Task_SelectItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04_OrderFork_SetPayment" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderFork" targetRef="Task_SetPaymentMethod"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05_SelectItems_ItemsFork" sourceRef="Task_SelectItems" targetRef="Gateway_ItemsFork"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06_ItemsFork_ChooseReward" sourceRef="Gateway_ItemsFork" targetRef="Task_ChooseReward"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07_ItemsFork_PaymentJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_ItemsFork" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08_SetPayment_PaymentJoin" sourceRef="Task_SetPaymentMethod" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09_PaymentJoin_PaymentSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentJoin" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10_PaymentSplit_Pay" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentSplit" targetRef="Task_Pay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11_PaymentSplit_Installment" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentSplit" targetRef="Task_CompleteInstallment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12_Pay_PaymentMerge" sourceRef="Task_Pay" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13_Installment_PaymentMerge" sourceRef="Task_CompleteInstallment" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14_PaymentMerge_FinalJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentMerge" targetRef="Gateway_FinalJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15_ChooseReward_FinalJoin" sourceRef="Task_ChooseReward" targetRef="Gateway_FinalJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16_FinalJoin_DeliveryMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_FinalJoin" targetRef="Gateway_DeliveryMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17_DeliveryMerge_Deliver" sourceRef="Gateway_DeliveryMerge" targetRef="Task_DeliverItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18_Deliver_ReturnSplit" sourceRef="Task_DeliverItems" targetRef="Gateway_ReturnSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19_ReturnSplit_ReturnItems" sourceRef="Gateway_ReturnSplit" targetRef="Task_ReturnItems">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${itemsReturned == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20_ReturnSplit_End" sourceRef="Gateway_ReturnSplit" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21_ReturnItems_DeliveryMerge" sourceRef="Task_ReturnItems" targetRef="Gateway_DeliveryMerge"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
